description: This Java class 'FreeMarkerWorker' provides utilities for working with the FreeMarker template engine within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for configuration, template rendering, cache management, exception handling, and integration with OFBiz components and properties.

classes.name: FreeMarkerWorker.FlexibleTemplateLoader
classes.description: Custom URLTemplateLoader for locating templates by resource identifier, supporting component:// format.

methods.name: getDefaultOfbizWrapper
methods.description: Returns the default BeansWrapper configured for OFBiz.

methods.name: newConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new FreeMarker Configuration instance with default settings.

methods.name: makeConfiguration
methods.description: Initializes a FreeMarker Configuration with custom settings, class resolvers, and transforms.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a FreeMarker template with a given context and output writer.

methods.name: renderTemplateFromString
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a template from a string and renders it.

methods.name: clearTemplateFromCache
methods.description: Removes a template from the cache.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a Template object from cache or loads it.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from a map, considering the FreeMarker environment.

methods.name: getWrappedObject
methods.description: Extracts the wrapped Java object from a FreeMarker variable.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves and unwraps a value from a SimpleHash with fallback to context.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a FreeMarker TemplateModel to a Java object.

methods.name: createEnvironmentMap
methods.description: Creates a map of current FreeMarker environment variables.

methods.name: saveContextValues
methods.description: Saves specified context values into a map.

methods.name: saveValues
methods.description: Creates a copy of specified context values.

methods.name: reloadValues
methods.description: Restores saved values into context and environment.

methods.name: removeValues
methods.description: Removes specified keys from a context map.

methods.name: overrideWithArgs
methods.description: Overrides context entries with provided arguments.

methods.name: getSiteParameters
methods.description: Populates context with site parameters from HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: autoWrap
methods.description: Wraps a Java object into a FreeMarker TemplateModel.

methods.name: handleTemplateException
methods.description: Handles template exceptions quietly, logs error, and writes a message.

methods.name: handleTemplateExceptionVerbosily
methods.description: Handles template exceptions verbosely, logs error, and writes the message.
